question: Does increasing only spatial output resolution (512x320 -> 768x448) materially improve preservation of the fast-moving mace while retaining the already-proven articulation and timing?
baseline: ltx25-m2b-strike (ORIGINAL-SPEED M2-B, 512x320); the slowed retry ltx25-m2b-strike-retry is secondary context only
controlled: static camera (lens 35 mm, sensor 36 mm, AUTO fit)
depth convention (per-clip min-max disparity, lossless full-range)
control_diagnostic pre-registered checks (unchanged spec tracking section)
resolution_derived_consequences: aspect 1.600 -> 1.714 with the horizontal FOV kept (AUTO sensor fit): vertical FOV 35.6 -> 33.4 deg; no subject cropping (gate in_frame)
Union guide grid 8x5 -> 12x7 cells, 64 output px per cell at both (latent W/32 x H/32; guide resized to latent x 32 / 2; dilated x2)
VAEDecodeTiled official tile 512 / overlap 64: one tile at 512x320, real spatial tiling at 768x448
per-clip depth normalisation unchanged (near 4.2024 m, far ~23.19 m); background fraction 5.4% -> 4.3% (vertical crop)

geometry_gt.note: speed per frame in head diameters is the same at both sizes; no outcome is predicted

metrics.retention: per frame: generated / reference area of the validated 'gold' colour mask (same resolution, same tracker)
metrics.shaft_continuity: visual, each worst-region frame: continuous / partial / absent (hand-to-head shaft)
metrics.ghost: visual: a frame in the fast region where the head is semi-transparent (background visible through it)

guards: timing check followed (M2-B spec: apex/contact within 2 frames, excursion >= 50%, detected >= 90%)
weapon arm visibly articulates guard -> wind-up/apex -> strike/contact -> recovery, not worse than 512 (visual)
temple structure coherent enough to judge (visual; static drift report-only)

classification_rules.COMPUTE-NOT-ADMITTED: checked first: no valid output because of OOM / allocation failure / killed / timeout, or completion with pagefile growth > 1024 MB, or generation wall time > 98 s (3x the 512 baseline 32.6 s) with memory pressure in the monitor. No tuning and no automatic retry.
classification_rules.REGRESSION: any guard fails, or fast_median < 0.470 (baseline - 0.10), or >= 2 severe frames in the fast region
classification_rules.STRONG IMPROVEMENT: guards hold and all of: fast_worst >= 0.50; fast_median >= 0.75; no severe frame in the fast region; no ghost frame; shaft continuous in >= 2 of the 3 worst-region frames
classification_rules.MODEST IMPROVEMENT: guards hold, not STRONG, not REGRESSION, and at least one of: no severe frame in the fast region; fast_median >= 0.670 (baseline + 0.10); shaft continuous in >= 1 worst-region frame
classification_rules.NO MATERIAL IMPROVEMENT: guards hold, not REGRESSION, and none of the MODEST conditions
classification_rules.order: COMPUTE-NOT-ADMITTED, REGRESSION, STRONG, MODEST, NO MATERIAL IMPROVEMENT

report_only: retention normalised by each run's outside-fast median
general visual quality (subject sharpness, temple detail, edge stability, temporal coherence)
budget: one generation; no second seed, resolution, upscaler, steps or guide-strength change
